other_failure_modes.name: CV Data Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: The agent imputes missing values on the entire training set before splitting it into cross-validation folds. This causes data leakage from the validation folds into the training folds during CV, making the validation scores unreliable.

other_failure_modes.name: Incorrect metric calculation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent calculates Mean Squared Error (MSE) but incorrectly logs and interprets it as Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE).

summary: The agent implements a basic LightGBM model with 5-fold cross-validation. However, the solution contains critical flaws: it selects the 'best' fold model for final predictions (causing optimistic bias), leaks data across CV folds by imputing before the split, calculates MSE instead of RMSE, and lacks any feature engineering.
